Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with ongoing right shoulder pain and reduced range of
motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the collision. Over the course of
fourteen visits, treatment included physical therapy, graded range-of-motion exercises, and home exercise
instruction. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, with progress tracked at each
visit. Examination revealed positive findings in the supraspinatus and impingement testing, supporting a soft tissue
injury to the shoulder, while several other orthopedic and neurological tests returned normal results. No prior injury or
treatment to the same shoulder is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this episode of care show no
duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Current status is improved strength and motion, with continued
home exercise and reassessment planned if symptoms persist.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
